ends.note: short stub north of W. 2nd ends at the C.C.C.&St.L. freight house tracks

notes: Central printed 'CENTRAL AV.'. Sweeney printed 'SWEENEY (WEBB)' (20 ft); between Smith and the C.&O. tracks it is marked 'DRIVEWAY 12' AB. STREET' (raised driveway over the street) and it stops at John (post office on the east side). Smith is about 51 ft between block lines north of W. 4th and 60 ft south of it (west side steps out); pick averages the four corners. John stops at W. 3rd: south of W. 3rd is the Central Union Station forecourt and train shed; John reappears as a stub between the freight-house tracks and W. 2nd and continues south of W. 2nd onto sheet 3. W. Pearl enters from the east (sheet 12) at Central in two legs, both printed 'W. PEARL' (about 43 ft each, separated by a 62 ft block); the north leg is at y~2994 and the south leg at y~3356, recorded as two Central/W. Pearl T's. The Central Union Station buildings close the west side of Central there (Central passes over 'R.R. tracks under street' between the legs). A vertical '50'' label at (3430,3450) in the open ground west of Central near the south Pearl leg is not assigned to a street. The W. 4th, W. 3rd and W. 2nd 66 ft labels are read; Central 60' labels at W. 4th and W. 2nd. Picks use block corners; the Smith and John water pipes run 5-10 px west of the centrelines.
